lines: You cook on Wednesday and Saturday, and that is what was kept.
The shared dish is vegan: that is what Theodule eats.
To stay inside it, expensive proteins give first, then out-of-season produce, then variety — never the portions.

dishes.name: Smoky Black Bean & Tomato Pot
dishes.title: Smoky black bean stew with crusty bread
dishes.method: Reheat the black bean stew portion in a small pan until bubbling. Serve in a bowl with the bread on the side.
dishes.why: This vegan dish provides a hearty, smoky lunch that meets the house's request for slow-cooked flavours using plant-based protein.

dishes.name: Rich Beef & Smoked Paprika Stew
dishes.title: Smoky beef and tomato stew with crusty bread
dishes.method: Reheat the beef stew in a pan over medium heat until piping hot. Serve with the bread.
dishes.why: Aurele's own dish uses beef to satisfy the smoky, slow-cooked theme while providing a high-protein lunch.

dishes.name: Charred Cauliflower & Chickpea Roast
dishes.title: Smoky roasted cauliflower and chickpeas with quinoa
dishes.method: Reheat the cauliflower and chickpea mix in the oven at 180C for 10 minutes. Reheat the quinoa in a pan with a splash of water. Combine and serve.
dishes.why: A vegan dinner featuring a loud vegetable (cauliflower) and a warm grain, fulfilling the coach's dinner requirements.

dishes.name: Smoky Paprika Chicken & Cauliflower
dishes.title: Roasted smoky chicken thighs with cauliflower and quinoa
dishes.method: Reheat the chicken and cauliflower in the oven until hot. Reheat the quinoa in a pan. Serve with the cauliflower as the primary focus.
dishes.why: This protein-rich dish uses the single oven tray efficiently to provide a warm, smoky dinner for Aurele.

preparations.title: Rich Smoky Beef Stew
preparations.method: Brown the beef in oil in a large pot. Add onions and garlic, cooking until soft. Stir in paprika, tomatoes, and stock. Cover and simmer on low heat for 40 minutes until the beef is tender.

preparations.title: Smoky Black Bean Stew
preparations.method: Sauté onion and garlic in oil. Add paprika, beans, tomatoes, and stock. Simmer for 20 minutes until thickened and flavours are deep.

preparations.title: Smoky Roast Chicken & Cauliflower
preparations.method: Toss chicken and cauliflower with oil and paprika. Spread on one half of the oven tray (sharing with the chickpeas). Roast at 200C for 35 minutes until the chicken is cooked through and cauliflower is charred.

preparations.title: Smoky Roast Chickpeas & Cauliflower
preparations.method: Toss chickpeas and cauliflower with oil and paprika. Spread on the other half of the oven tray. Roast at 200C for 25-30 minutes until crisp.

preparations.title: Basic Cooked Quinoa
preparations.method: Rinse quinoa. Bring water to a boil, add quinoa, cover and simmer for 15 minutes. Remove from heat and let stand for 5 minutes before fluffing with a fork.

cooking_sessions.run_through: Start by putting the quinoa on the hob. Preheat the oven to 200C. Chop all vegetables. Start the beef stew and the bean stew in separate pots on the hob. While they simmer, arrange the chicken and chickpeas on the single oven tray (separated) and put them in the oven. Fluff the quinoa when done. Once the stews and roast are finished, weigh and box into the named containers.
